name: Twin Soul
source:
Why monsters and humans have to fight each other? Aren't monsters being just manipulated by the mastermind?
Main heroine is a demon who has both human and demon traits. She is sent as a spy to the camp of the heroes of Dragon Quest 4. But maybe we can all coexist happily together.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
为什么怪物和人类必须互相争斗？怪物不就是被主脑操纵的吗？
女主角是一位兼具人类和恶魔特征的恶魔。她作为间谍被派往《勇者斗恶龙4》英雄营地。但也许我们可以幸福地共存。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
